description: Binary assertion tests for /pre-commit skill output quality

tests.name: clean_rust_passes
tests.description: Clean Rust code with proper error handling, no unwrap. Should pass all checks.
tests.prompt: Run /pre-commit on this diff. Clean Rust function with Result return type, no unwrap, no silent errors.

assertions.check: Output indicates pass/safe to commit
Output mentions Code Safety Scan was run
Output does NOT flag any unwrap violations
Output mentions fail-closed check passed
Output is concise (under 500 words for a clean pass)

tests.name: unwrap_in_production_flagged
tests.description: Two .unwrap() calls in PolicyGuard production code. Must be flagged.
tests.prompt: Run /pre-commit on this diff. Adds .unwrap() calls in policy/guard.rs production code.

assertions.check: Output flags unwrap() usage
Output indicates fail/not safe to commit
Output references guard.rs
Output suggests using ? or ok_or instead
Output mentions this is production code (not test)

tests.name: fail_open_default_flagged
tests.description: TradingMode::Active as error fallback. Classic fail-open violation.
tests.prompt: Run /pre-commit on this diff. Changes error fallback from ReduceOnly to Active.

assertions.check: Output flags TradingMode::Active as unsafe default
Output mentions ReduceOnly or Kill as the correct default
Output indicates fail for fail-closed check
Output references engine.rs
Output explains the risk (trading when policy unavailable)

tests.name: silent_error_flagged
tests.description: let _ = self.log_rejection() silently ignores logging error. Must flag.
tests.prompt: Run /pre-commit on this diff. Uses let _ = to ignore a logging result in a gate.

assertions.check: Output flags let _ = pattern
Output indicates this is a safety concern
Output references net_edge_gate.rs
Output suggests proper error handling
Output also notes the Option wrapping of max_edge_usd changes semantics

tests.name: missing_trip_test_flagged
tests.description: New VolatilityGate with no acceptance tests at all. Must flag missing TRIP/NON-TRIP.
tests.prompt: Run /pre-commit on this diff. Adds new VolatilityGate with no tests.

assertions.check: Output flags missing TRIP/NON-TRIP tests
Output flags missing AT registration
Output references volatility_gate
Output indicates not safe to commit without tests
Output mentions causality proof requirement
